supporting_observations.claim: WS-BCARTER-01 generated repeated connections to the internal proxy at 10.30.20.30:8080 during the alert window, with several intervals close to five minutes (for example, 13:41:10, 13:46:34, 13:51:47, 13:55:57, 14:01:14, and 14:06:22 UTC).
The cited records identify connections from the workstation to the proxy, but do not identify the remote HTTPS destination or the originating process for those periodic connections.

The documented ChartMate updater checks for updates about every five minutes, so it is a possible legitimate explanation; however, the available records do not connect the periodic traffic to cmupdate.exe or update.chartmate-imaging.com.

Other proxy records in the window show that destination and application details can be recorded—for example, Chrome requests to SharePoint at 14:10—but those records do not establish the destination or process behind the earlier periodic connections.

known_telemetry_limitations: For the periodic flows, the supplied Zeek records show connections only to the internal proxy; corresponding proxy CONNECT or request records identifying destinations are not present.
The supplied records do not attribute the periodic proxy connections to a process or executable on WS-BCARTER-01.
The records therefore do not show whether the periodic activity was the documented ChartMate updater or another application.
claims_not_established: That the periodic connections reached update.chartmate-imaging.com or were generated by the approved ChartMate updater.
That the periodic connections reached a malicious destination or carried malicious content.
That the periodic traffic itself involved data theft, command-and-control, or another malicious action.
additional_evidence_needed: Proxy records for the periodic connection times, including CONNECT destination, request details, and any available TLS or tunnel identifiers.
Endpoint process-to-network telemetry for WS-BCARTER-01 covering the alert window, including process image, executable path, and signature.
If available, ChartMate updater execution or update-check logs for the alert window to confirm or rule out the documented explanation.
